request.name: List or found Trouble Ticket objects

description.content: The Buyer requests a list of Trouble Tickets from the Seller based on a set of specified filter criteria. The Seller returns a summarized list of Trouble Tickets.

query.description: ID given by the consumer and only understandable by him (to facilitate his searches afterward)

The priority (ITIL) is based on the assessment of the impact and urgency of how quickly the Ticket should be resolved as evaluated by the Buyer. The Priority is used by the Seller to determine the order in which Tickets get resolved across Buyers.
The priority (ITIL) is based on the assessment of the impact and urgency of how quickly the Ticket should be resolved after evaluation by the Seller of the impact of the Issue on the Buyer.
The severity or impact (ITIL) of the Ticket as evaluated by the Buyer.
The severity or impact (ITIL) of the Ticket on the Buyer as evaluated by the Seller.
The presumed cause of the Trouble Ticket as evaluated by the Buyer.
The current status of the Trouble Ticket
The type of impact observed by the Buyer.
ID of a related entity that this ticket is related to and is present in the `relatedEntity` list
Type of a related entity that this ticket is related to and is present in the `relatedEntity` list
The date on which the Trouble Ticket was created - greater than
The date on which the Trouble Ticket was created - lower than
The date provided by the Seller to indicate when the Ticket is expected to be resolved - greater than
The date provided by the Seller to indicate when the Ticket is expected to be resolved - lower than
The date the Ticket status was set to resolved by the Seller - greater than
The date the Ticket status was set to resolved by the Seller - lower than
The unique identifier of the organization that is acting as the a Buyer. MUST be specified in the request only when the requester represents more than one Buyer.
The unique identifier of the organization that is acting as the Seller. MUST be specified in the request only when responding entity represents more than one Seller.
Requested index for start of resources to be provided in response
Requested number of resources to be provided in response

description.content:
**This file forms part of Mplify 124.1**

This API implements Business Requirements described in MEF 113

It allows the Buyer to create, retrieve, and update Trouble Tickets as well
as receive notifications about Incidents' and Trouble Tickets' updates.
This allows managing issues and situations that are not part of normal
operations of the Product provided by the Seller.

List of supported use cases:
- Create Ticket
- Retrieve Ticket List
- Retrieve Ticket by Ticket Identifier
- Patch Ticket by Ticket Identifier
- Cancel Ticket by Ticket Identifier
- Ticket Resolution Confirmation
- Retrieve Incident List
- Retrieve Incident by Incident Identifier
- Register for Event Notifications
